youtube.title: GTA 6 Has a UFO. Your Eyes Can Make One Too #Shorts
youtube.description:
In GTA 6, players say a UFO shows up on a dark road after two in the morning. Your own eyes can make one too.

Player guides report that a UFO encounter can start on a quiet road after 2:00 AM in the game (a starting point, not a guarantee). In real life, a single small light in the dark can seem to drift even when it is perfectly still: the autokinetic effect. Your eyes are never perfectly still, and with nothing next to the light to compare with, your brain blames the light. It was recorded over a hundred years ago (Adams, 1912) and studied by Muzafer Sherif in the 1930s, who had people in a dark room watch one still dot of light. Give the light a reference, like a branch, and it stops.

In March 2024 the Pentagon's AARO reviewed UFO investigations from 1945 to 2023 and found no evidence of alien technology; most sightings were misidentified ordinary objects and phenomena.

So, what have you seen in the sky?

sources.fact: GTA 6: player guides report a UFO encounter can start on a quiet road (NW of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County) after 2:00 AM, without your partner; players say, not guaranteed
Same UFO starting point reported by a second guide
Players report UFO abductions in GTA 6
Autokinetic effect: a small still light in a dark, featureless field appears to move when it lacks a frame of reference; recorded by Adams (1912); Gregory: misread eye movements
Sherif (1935): people alone in a dark room watched a still point of light and reported it moving
AARO Historical Record Report Vol. I (March 2024): reviewed 1945 to Oct 2023; no evidence of extraterrestrial technology; most sightings were misidentified ordinary objects and phenomena
